acquisition method: MS data were acquired in a data-dependent mode
cleavage agent: ESP sample was digested using filter-aided sample preparation with 1 μg of trypsin
instrument: analysed in a mass spectrometer (Orbitrap Elite, Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization type: Eluted peptides (2 μg) were ionised by a nanospray (PicoView 550 nano source)
labeling: LC-MS/MS spectrometry analysis identified 721 proteins secreted by E. nipponicum
